defender.label: Defender
defender.description: Soaks damage and shields allies behind it. Kill it last, or push past it.

attacker.label: Attacker
attacker.description: Straightforward frontline bruiser — high uptime melee pressure.

dps_ranged.label: Ranged DPS
dps_ranged.description: Hangs back and plinks your line from a distance. Close the gap fast.

dps_caster.label: Caster DPS
dps_caster.description: Channels elemental nukes. Interrupt the cast or eat the burst.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Mends its allies faster than you can chip them. Focus it first.

cc.label: Crowd Control
cc.description: Locks your heroes down with slows, roots, and stuns. Brings denial, not damage.

swarm.label: Swarm
swarm.description: Weak alone, lethal in numbers — overwhelms with sheer body count.

trap.label: Trap
trap.description: Disguised or buried until you commit, then springs an ambush.

boss_tier.label: Boss-Tier
boss_tier.description: An encounter unto itself — phased, mechanic-heavy, arena-defining.

creatures.behavior: Oozes forward in clumps; splits into smaller slimes when struck hard.
Darts in for a quick stab, then scampers back before you can retaliate.
Erratic flight makes it hard to pin; harasses backline casters.
Skitters along the ground and latches on, grinding down armor over time.
Hunts in a pack — circles to flank, then pounces on the weakest hero.
Flits in and out of range, loosing quick elemental motes between dashes.
Drifts to wounded allies and knits their wounds with a soft glow.
Hurls hexes from cover and cackles; prioritizes whoever it last hit.
Tiny and disposable — arrives in a flood meant to soak your attacks.
Lowers its head and charges in a straight line, trampling anything in its lane.
Coils around a target and constricts — a venom bite that slows for several turns.
Spins webbing that roots a hero in place; loves to trap your healer.
A walking wall — enormous HP, plants itself between you and the real threat.
Raises its shield to taunt and absorb blows aimed at the casters behind it.
Chants restorative totems; out-heals your damage unless silenced or burst down.
Nocks an arrow from max range and aims for the squishiest hero in your line.
Channels a heavy elemental nuke — interrupt the cast or eat the full burst.
A feral bruiser that enrages as it loses HP, hitting harder the closer to death it gets.
A tireless guardian that reflects a share of melee damage back at the attacker.
Takes flight and breathes a cone of elemental ruin across your whole front line.
Swoops, strikes, and retreats out of reach — a flying skirmisher that never sits still.
Sits disguised as treasure until a hero gets close, then ambushes with a crushing bite.
Burrows underground and erupts beneath your backline when you least expect it.
Immobile but radiates a steady aura that buffs and heals every nearby enemy.
A phased apparition — turns intangible between attacks, forcing you to time your burst.
